events.verdict: Waiters (MIA) brings one hand to the opposite side of Cauley-Stein's (SAC) body but he immediately removes it.
Whiteside (MIA) makes contact to the body of Bogdanovic (SAC) at the end of the drive but the contact is marginal.
Richardson (MIA) wraps Cauley-Stein (SAC) on the screen and grabs his jersey, affecting his ability to defend the play.
RAR shows that prior to the clean block by Cauley-Stein (SAC), Bogdanovic (SAC) reaches in and makes contact to the arm of Whiteside (MIA) during his shot attempt near the rim.
Richardson (MIA) reaches in and makes contact with Bogdanovic (SAC) that causes him to lose control of the ball.
Adebayo (MIA) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Barnes (SAC) and is firming up over his right leg when the contact occurs.
Barnes (SAC) briefly places a hand/arm to the front of Wade (MIA) as both players move around the pick but the contact is marginal.
Winslow (MIA) jumps from point A to point B and makes contact with Hield (SAC) that affects his driving shot attempt.
Adebayo (MIA) sets the pick on Fox (SAC) but he delivers contact that affects his ability to defend.
Richardson (MIA) makes incidental "high-five" contact with Hield (SAC) after the release that does not affect his jump shot attempt.
Adebayo (MIA) and Cauley-Stein (SAC) engage and disengage without affecting each other's ability to retrieve the rebound.
Barnes (SAC) places a forearm on Wade's (MIA) body during the drive but the contact is marginal and does not affect his ability to make the pass.
RLS shows Winslow (MIA) makes contact with the ball and then incidental contact with Fox's (SAC) arm during his driving shot attempt.
Richardson (MIA) makes marginal contact to Hield's (SAC) arm and he is able to move through the contact and finish at the rim.
Hield (SAC) maintains a legal guarding position during the jump shot attempt by Wade (MIA).
Winslow (MIA) commits a take foul on Cauley-Stein (SAC).
Winslow (MIA) gathers the ball and legally takes two steps.
Hield (SAC) maintains a legal guarding position during the driving shot attempt by Winslow (MIA).
Cauley-Stein (SAC) makes incidental contact with Winslow's (MIA) head during the rebound.
[Observable in enhanced video] Richardson (MIA) lifts his pivot foot at the start of his dribble.
The ball is last touched by Winslow (MIA) prior to going OOB.
Winslow (MIA) commits a take foul on Hield (SAC).
